org.drip.product.muni

Packages that use org.drip.product.muni
Package Description
org.drip.product.muni
Refunding and Optimal Exercise Mechanics
  • Classes in org.drip.product.muni used by org.drip.product.muni
    Class Description
    CurveMeasures
    CurveMeasures holds the Bond Measures computed at the Specified Dates using the Market Yield Curves.
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudin
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudin evolves the Market Yield Term Structure for Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yield Curves using the de Guillaume, Rebonato, and Pogudin (2013) scheme.
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudinMarketSettings
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudinMarketSettings holds the Market Yield Term Structure for Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yield Curves.
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudinPath
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudinPath holds the Single Path Simulated Market Yield Term Structure for Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yield Curves using Ornstein-Uhlenbeck augmented de Guillaume, Rebonato, and Pogudin (2013) Scheme.
    MarketYieldTermStructure
    MarketYieldTermStructure holds the Spot and the Infinite Horizon Yields for a given Muni Sub-market, i.e., Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yield Curves.
    OrrDeLaNuez2013
    OrrDeLaNuez2013 performs a Monte-Carlo Evolution of the Market Yield Term Structure for Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yield Curves using the de Guillaume, Rebonato, and Pogudin (2013) Scheme.
    RefinancingEnsemblePnL
    RefinancingEnsemblePnL holds the Ensemble of Bond PnL's incurred across multiple Paths and Dates by re-financing using simulated Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, and Taxable Path Yield Curves.
    RefinancingEnsemblePnLThinStatistics
    RefinancingEnsemblePnL holds the Ensemble of Bond PnL's incurred across multiple Paths and Dates by re-financing using simulated Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, and Taxable Path Yield Curves.
    RefinancingPathPnLEntry
    RefinancingPathPnLEntry contains the Entries corresponding to the Single Path/Date Bond PnL incurred by re-financing using Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, and Taxable Path Yield Curves.
    RefinancingPathPnLGenerator
    RefinancingPathPnLGenerator generates the Single Path Bond PnL incurred by re-financing using Muni Sub-markets, i.e., Tax-exempt, and Taxable Path Yield Curves.
